reason: I already pay for vidIQ and use only half of it, so I don't need another tool that promises the same thing. An app I've never heard of asking to read my whole YouTube account is a no for me before I even see what it does.
objection: I don't want to give an unknown app access to my YouTube account. Read-only still means it sees my analytics, my channel and my audience data, and I don't know who runs Mitra or what they do with it.
would_change_my_mind: A creator I trust in my WhatsApp group using it and saying the Hindi or Telugu title and thumbnail ideas actually beat what I'd have done, plus a way to try it on one video without connecting my whole channel.
